summary.goal: Configure Renovate: group GitHub Actions updates with 14-day cooldown and auto-merge for patch/minor/digest; prefix PR titles with [skip memex] so renovate PRs don't trigger memex-check.
decisions: Used commitMessagePrefix instead of branchPrefix/prTitle so [skip memex] lands at the front of both commit messages and PR titles in one place. Renovate derives titles from commit messages, so a single field covers both.
Borrowed the github-actions packageRule from 20jasper/JJPWRGEM verbatim: matchUpdateTypes patch/minor/digest, automerge enabled, minimumReleaseAge 14 days. Major bumps stay manual.
